subject: infoschema: Exchange partition did not update the potential new AutoID (#64248)
summary: Infoschema builder now avoids reusing cached autoid allocators when applying `ActionExchangeTablePartition`, forcing allocator reload so the in-memory `_tidb_rowid`/AutoID state reflects the post-exchange meta updates and prevents ID reuse/collisions after EXCHANGE PARTITION; includes regression coverage for #64176.
